          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Install FUSE driver ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install FUSE and Tauri deps (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev fuse3 libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 libayatana-appindicator3-1
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          ./desktop-binary/cipherbox-desktop --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:
          run: |
            export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            ./desktop-binary/cipherbox-desktop --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath ".\desktop-binary\cipherbox-desktop.exe" -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

    22→/// Register this desktop device in the encrypted device registry.
    23→///
    24→/// Steps:
    25→/// 1. Derive registry IPNS keypair via HKDF
    26→/// 2. Try to resolve existing registry from IPNS
    27→/// 3. Build device entry for this desktop
    28→/// 4. Update or create registry with the device entry
    29→/// 5. Encrypt registry with user's public key (ECIES)
    30→/// 6. Upload to IPFS and publish IPNS record
    31→///
    32→/// This function should be called via `tokio::spawn` so failures never block login.
    33→pub async fn register_device(
    34→    api: &Arc<ApiClient>,
    35→    private_key: &[u8; 32],
    36→    public_key: &[u8],
    37→    _user_id: &str,
    38→) -> Result<(), String> {
    39→    // 1. Derive registry IPNS keypair via HKDF
    40→    let (reg_ipns_priv, _reg_ipns_pub, reg_ipns_name) =
    41→        crypto::hkdf::derive_registry_ipns_keypair(private_key)
    42→            .map_err(|e| format!("Registry IPNS derivation failed: {}", e))?;
    43→
    44→    // 2. Try to resolve existing registry from IPNS
    45→    let existing_registry = match fetch_and_decrypt_registry(api, &reg_ipns_name, private_key).await
    46→    {
    47→        Ok(reg) => Some(reg),
    48→        Err(_) => None, // No registry exists yet (first device)
    49→    };
    50→
    51→    // 3. Build device entry for this desktop
    52→    let device_id = get_or_create_device_id();
    53→    let device_entry = DeviceEntry {
    54→        device_id: device_id.clone(),
    55→        public_key: hex::encode(public_key),
    56→        name: get_device_name(),
    57→        platform: get_device_platform(),
    58→        app_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
    59→        device_model: get_device_model(),
    60→        ip_hash: String::new(), // Not tracked for desktop
    61→        status: if existing_registry.is_none() {
    62→            DeviceAuthStatus::Authorized // First device auto-authorized
    63→        } else {
    64→            DeviceAuthStatus::Pending
    65→        },
    66→        created_at: now_ms(),
    67→        last_seen_at: now_ms(),
    68→        revoked_at: None,
    69→        revoked_by: None,
    70→    };
    71→
    72→    // 4. Build updated registry
    73→    let mut registry = existing_registry.unwrap_or(DeviceRegistry {
    74→        version: "v1".to_string(),
    75→        sequence_number: 0,
    76→        devices: vec![],
    77→    });

    79→    // Update existing device entry or add new one

    81→        .devices

file.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages (excluding desktop)
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api --filter @cipherbox/web build

  cargo-check-windows:
    name: Cargo Check (Windows)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with winfsp feature
        run: cargo check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-check-macos:
    name: Cargo Check (macOS)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-check-linux:
    name: Cargo Check (Linux)
    needs: [changes, lint]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true')
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Cargo check with fuse feature
        working-directory: apps/desktop/src-tauri
        run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  build-desktop-windows:
    name: Build Windows Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $resourceDir = "${{ github.workspace }}/apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources"
          $out = "$resourceDir/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $resourceDir
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-windows
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop.exe
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-desktop-macos:
    name: Build macOS Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-macos
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-desktop-linux:
    name: Build Linux Desktop
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux, typecheck]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      github.event_name == 'push' &&
      needs.changes.outputs.desktop == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - name: Build debug binary for E2E
        run: cargo build --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse

      - name: Upload debug desktop binary
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: desktop-debug-linux
          path: apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/cipherbox-desktop
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

file.content:
name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_id:
        description: 'CI workflow run ID to download artifacts from (optional, uses latest if empty)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  actions: read

jobs:
  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success')
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            artifact: desktop-debug-macos
            fuse-feature: fuse
            shell: bash
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            artifact: desktop-debug-windows
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            shell: powershell
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            artifact: desktop-debug-linux
            fuse-feature: fuse
            shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # --- Download desktop binary from CI build ---

      - name: Find latest CI run ID
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_id == ''
        id: find-run
        shell: bash
        run: |
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --workflow=ci.yml --branch=main --status=success --limit=1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId')
          if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ] || [ "$RUN_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "No successful CI run found on main branch." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "run_id=$RUN_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Download debug binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact }}
          path: desktop-binary/
          run-id: ${{ inputs.run_id || steps.find-run.outputs.run_id || github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Make binary executable
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: chmod +x desktop-binary/cipherbox-desktop

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Install FUSE driver ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install FUSE and Tauri deps (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev fuse3 libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 libayatana-appindicator3-1
          sudo modprobe fuse || true

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop

          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:

            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            ./desktop-binary/cipherbox-desktop --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath ".\desktop-binary\cipherbox-desktop.exe" -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

[package]
name = "cipherbox-desktop"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[features]
default = ["fuse"]
fuse = ["dep:fuser", "dep:unicode-normalization"]
winfsp = ["dep:winfsp", "dep:widestring"]

[dependencies]
tauri = { version = "2", features = ["tray-icon", "image-png", "image-ico"] }
tauri-plugin-deep-link = "2"
tauri-plugin-autostart = "2"
tauri-plugin-shell = "2"
tauri-plugin-notification = "2"
fuser = { version = "0.16", default-features = false, features = ["libfuse"], optional = true }
keyring = { version = "3", features = ["apple-native", "windows-native", "linux-native-sync-persistent"] }
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json", "rustls-tls", "multipart"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
aes = "0.8"
aes-gcm = "0.10"
ctr = "0.9"
hkdf = "0.12"
sha2 = "0.10"
ecies = { version = "0.2", default-features = false, features = ["pure"] }
ed25519-dalek = { version = "2", features = ["rand_core"] }
rand = "0.8"
hex = "0.4"
base64 = "0.22"
dirs = "5"
log = "0.4"
env_logger = "0.11"
thiserror = "2"
zeroize = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
prost = "0.13"
ciborium = "0.2"
multihash = "0.19"
unsigned-varint = "0.8"
urlencoding = "2"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
hostname = "0.4"
dotenvy = "0.15"
unicode-normalization = { version = "0.1.25", optional = true }
winfsp = { version = "0.12", optional = true }
widestring = { version = "1", optional = true }

[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
winreg = "0.55"

[target.'cfg(unix)'.dependencies]
libc = "0.2"

[target.'cfg(windows)'.build-dependencies]
winfsp = "0.12"

[build-dependencies]
tauri-build = { version = "2", features = [] }

[patch.crates-io]
# Patched fuser with loop-read for FUSE-T socket compatibility.
# FUSE-T communicates via Unix domain socket (not /dev/fuse), so large
# FUSE messages can arrive in fragments. Stock fuser does a single read()
# and fails with "Short read of FUSE request". This patch loop-reads
# until the full message is received.
fuser = { path = "vendor/fuser" }

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  changes:
    name: Detect Changes
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      src: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.src }}
      desktop: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.desktop }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        id: filter
        with:
          filters: |
            src:
              - 'apps/**'
              - 'packages/**'
              - 'tee-worker/**'
              - 'tests/**'
              - '.github/**'
              - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
              - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
              - 'tsconfig*.json'
              - 'biome.json'
            desktop:
              - 'apps/desktop/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/capabilities/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/**'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/build.rs'
              - 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/rust-toolchain.toml'
              - 'apps/desktop/index.html'
              - 'apps/desktop/vite.config.*'
              - 'apps/desktop/tsconfig*'
              - 'packages/crypto/src/**'
              - 'packages/crypto/tsconfig*'
              - '.github/workflows/ci.yml'

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run linter
        run: pnpm lint

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run type checker
        run: pnpm typecheck

  api-spec:
    name: Verify API Spec & Client
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: cipherbox_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate OpenAPI spec and API client
        run: pnpm api:generate
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Format generated files
        run: |
          pnpm eslint --fix apps/web/src/api/ || true
          pnpm prettier --write packages/api-client/openapi.json apps/web/src/api/

      - name: Verify no uncommitted changes to generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code packages/api-client/openapi.json || (echo "OpenAPI spec is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)
          git diff --exit-code apps/web/src/api/ || (echo "Generated API client is out of date. Run 'pnpm api:generate' and commit changes." && exit 1)

  migration-check:
    name: Migration Drift Check
    needs: [changes]
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16-alpine

          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres

          --health-timeout 5s

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run existing migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Check for entity/migration drift
        working-directory: apps/api
        run: |
          set +e
          OUTPUT="$(pnpm typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/DriftCheck -d src/data-source.ts 2>&1)"
          STATUS=$?
          set -e

          # Check if migration:generate failed before inspecting output files
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
            if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q "No changes in database schema were found"; then
              echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "::error::migration:generate failed unexpectedly."
            echo "$OUTPUT"
            exit 1
          fi

          if ls src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts 1>/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # Our hand-written migrations use explicit constraint/index names, but TypeORM
            # expects auto-generated hash-based names. Filter out cosmetic renames and only
            # fail on real structural drift (new/dropped tables, added/removed columns, type changes).
            if grep -qE 'CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|ADD COLUMN|DROP COLUMN|ALTER.*TYPE|RENAME COLUMN' src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts; then
              echo "::error::Entity/migration drift detected! Entities define schema changes not covered by migrations."
              echo ""
              echo "Generated migration contents:"
              cat src/migrations/*DriftCheck*.ts
              echo ""
              echo "Fix: Run 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api typeorm migration:generate src/migrations/<Name> -d src/data-source.ts' and commit the result."
              exit 1
            else
              echo "Only cosmetic constraint/index naming differences detected (not structural drift). OK."
            fi
          else
            echo "No entity/migration drift detected."
          fi
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

  test:
    name: Test

          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      ipfs:
        image: ipfs/kubo:v0.34.0
        ports:
          - 5001:5001
          - 8080:8080
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ipfs id"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 10
          --health-start-period 30s
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run API tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test:cov

          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080

      - name: Run Crypto tests with coverage
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto test:coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./apps/api/coverage/lcov.info,./packages/crypto/coverage/lcov.info
          flags: api,crypto
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  build:
    name: Build
    needs: [changes, lint, typecheck, api-spec, test, migration-check]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      (github.event_name == 'push' || needs.changes.outputs.src == 'true')

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4

      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop.exe
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            fuse-feature: fuse
            binary-name: cipherbox-desktop

    steps:

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update

            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \

            libfuse3-dev \

          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"

        run: |

          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 10

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build mock-ipns-routing
        run: cd tools/mock-ipns-routing && npm install && npm run build

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto --filter @cipherbox/api build

      # --- Configuration ---

      - name: Create API .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/api/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          NODE_ENV=test
          DB_HOST=localhost
          DB_PORT=5432
          DB_USERNAME=postgres
          DB_PASSWORD=postgres
          DB_DATABASE=cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET=e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER=local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL=http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

      - name: Create desktop .env
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > apps/desktop/.env << 'ENVEOF'
          VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF

      # --- Database + API startup ---

      - name: Run migrations
        run: pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api migration:run
        env:
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          NODE_ENV: test

      - name: Start mock IPNS routing
        shell: bash
        run: node tools/mock-ipns-routing/dist/index.js &

      - name: Start API server
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          cd apps/api
          node dist/main.js &
          # Wait for API readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:3000/health > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "API did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
        env:
          NODE_ENV: test
          DB_HOST: localhost
          DB_PORT: 5432
          DB_USERNAME: postgres
          DB_PASSWORD: postgres
          DB_DATABASE: cipherbox_test
          JWT_SECRET: e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key
          CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: http://localhost:5173
          IPFS_PROVIDER: local
          IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL: http://localhost:5001
          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL: http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST: localhost
          REDIS_PORT: 6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET: e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}

      - name: Start API server (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:NODE_ENV = "test"
          $env:DB_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:DB_PORT = "5432"
          $env:DB_USERNAME = "postgres"
          $env:DB_PASSWORD = "postgres"
          $env:DB_DATABASE = "cipherbox_test"
          $env:JWT_SECRET = "e2e-desktop-jwt-secret-key"
          $env:CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS = "http://localhost:5173"
          $env:IPFS_PROVIDER = "local"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_API_URL = "http://localhost:5001"
          $env:IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL = "http://localhost:8080"
          $env:DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL = "http://localhost:3001"
          $env:REDIS_HOST = "localhost"
          $env:REDIS_PORT = "6379"
          $env:TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY = "${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}"
          Start-Process -FilePath node -ArgumentList "dist/main.js" -WorkingDirectory "apps/api" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for API readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/health" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "API ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "API did not become ready in time." }

      # --- Desktop launch + test execution ---

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
          export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          export RUST_LOG=info
          BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
          chmod +x "$BINARY"
          DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
          "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
          DESKTOP_PID=$!
          set +e
          bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
          TEST_EXIT=$?
          set -e
          kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
          diskutil unmount force $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
          exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        uses: GabrielBB/xvfb-action@v1
        with:
          run: |
            export CIPHERBOX_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
            export VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
            export RUST_LOG=info
            BINARY=apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/${{ matrix.binary-name }}
            chmod +x "$BINARY"
            DEV_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
            "$BINARY" --dev-key $DEV_KEY &
            DESKTOP_PID=$!
            set +e
            bash tests/e2e-desktop/scripts/run-all.sh
            TEST_EXIT=$?
            set -e
            kill $DESKTOP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
            fusermount3 -u $HOME/CipherBox 2>/dev/null || true
            exit $TEST_EXIT

      - name: Run desktop E2E tests (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $env:CIPHERBOX_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_API_URL = "http://localhost:3000"
          $env:VITE_TEST_LOGIN_SECRET = "e2e-test-secret-ci-only"
          $env:RUST_LOG = "info"
          $BINARY = "apps\desktop\src-tauri\target\debug\${{ matrix.binary-name }}"
          $DEV_KEY = -join ((1..32) | ForEach-Object { '{0:x2}' -f (Get-Random -Max 256) })
          $proc = Start-Process -FilePath $BINARY -ArgumentList "--dev-key",$DEV_KEY -PassThru -NoNewWindow
          & "$PWD\tests\e2e-desktop\scripts\run-all.ps1"
          $testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          exit $testExit

      # --- Failure artifacts ---

      - name: Upload logs on failure
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-desktop-logs-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: |
            apps/api/*.log
            ~/Library/Logs/fuse-t/fuse-t.log
          retention-days: 7

name: Desktop E2E Tests

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ['CI']
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_id:
        description: 'CI workflow run ID to download artifacts from (optional, uses latest if empty)'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  actions: read

jobs:
  e2e-desktop:
    name: Desktop E2E (${{ matrix.platform }})
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' && github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success')
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: macos
            os: macos-latest
            artifact: desktop-debug-macos
            fuse-feature: fuse
            shell: bash
          - platform: windows
            os: windows-latest
            artifact: desktop-debug-windows
            fuse-feature: winfsp
            shell: powershell
          - platform: linux
            os: ubuntu-22.04
            artifact: desktop-debug-linux
            fuse-feature: fuse
            shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # --- Download desktop binary from CI build ---

      - name: Find latest CI run ID
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.run_id == ''
        id: find-run
        shell: bash
        run: |
          RUN_ID=$(gh run list --workflow=ci.yml --branch=main --status=success --limit=1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId')
          if [ -z "$RUN_ID" ] || [ "$RUN_ID" = "null" ]; then
            echo "No successful CI run found on main branch." >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "run_id=$RUN_ID" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Download debug binary
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.artifact }}
          path: desktop-binary/
          run-id: ${{ inputs.run_id || steps.find-run.outputs.run_id || github.event.workflow_run.id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Make binary executable
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: chmod +x desktop-binary/cipherbox-desktop

      # --- Install backend services ---

      - name: Setup PostgreSQL
        uses: ikalnytskyi/action-setup-postgres@v8
        with:
          username: postgres
          password: postgres
          database: cipherbox_test
          postgres-version: '16'
        id: postgres

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS)
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          KUBO_VERSION="v0.34.0"
          if [ "$(uname)" = "Darwin" ]; then
            ARCH="darwin-$(uname -m | sed 's/arm64/arm64/' | sed 's/x86_64/amd64/')"
          else
            ARCH="linux-amd64"
          fi
          wget -q "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/${KUBO_VERSION}/kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          tar -xzf "kubo_${KUBO_VERSION}_${ARCH}.tar.gz"
          sudo ./kubo/install.sh
          ipfs init
          ipfs daemon &
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          READY=0
          for i in $(seq 1 30); do
            if curl -s http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "IPFS daemon ready"
              READY=1
              break
            fi
            sleep 1
          done
          if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then
            echo "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install Kubo (IPFS) (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $version = "v0.34.0"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://dist.ipfs.tech/kubo/$version/kubo_${version}_windows-amd64.zip" -OutFile kubo.zip
          Expand-Archive -Path kubo.zip -DestinationPath .
          $env:PATH = "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH"
          [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("PATH", "$PWD\kubo;$env:PATH", "Process")
          echo "$PWD\kubo" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Append
          ipfs init
          Start-Process -FilePath "ipfs" -ArgumentList "daemon" -NoNewWindow
          # Wait for daemon readiness
          $ready = $false
          for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) {
            try {
              $null = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5001/api/v0/id" -ErrorAction Stop
              Write-Host "IPFS daemon ready"
              $ready = $true
              break
            } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
          }
          if (-not $ready) { throw "IPFS daemon did not become ready in time." }

      - name: Install Redis (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install redis
          brew services start redis

      - name: Install Redis (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y redis-server
          sudo systemctl start redis-server

      - name: Install Redis (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          choco install redis-64 -y
          Start-Process redis-server -NoNewWindow
          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3

      # --- Install FUSE driver ---

      - name: Install FUSE-T (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install FUSE and Tauri deps (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse3-dev fuse3 libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0 libayatana-appindicator3-1

      - name: Install WinFsp (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: powershell

          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      # --- Setup Node.js + pnpm ---

        with:

        with:

          IPFS_PROVIDER=local

          IPFS_LOCAL_GATEWAY_URL=http://localhost:8080
          DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL=http://localhost:3001
          REDIS_HOST=localhost
          REDIS_PORT=6379
          TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only
          ENVEOF
          echo "IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY=${{ secrets.IDENTITY_JWT_PRIVATE_KEY }}" >> apps/api/.env

run: cargo check --no-default-features --features fuse

  cargo-test-windows:
    name: Cargo Test (Windows)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-windows]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-windows.result == 'success'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install WinFsp
        shell: powershell
        run: |
          $url = "https://github.com/winfsp/winfsp/releases/download/v2.1/winfsp-2.1.25156.msi"
          $out = "winfsp.msi"
          $expectedHash = "073A70E00F77423E34BED98B86E600DEF93393BA5822204FAC57A29324DB9F7A"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $url -OutFile $out
          $actualHash = (Get-FileHash $out -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($actualHash -ne $expectedHash) { throw "WinFsp MSI hash mismatch: expected $expectedHash, got $actualHash" }
          Start-Process msiexec.exe -ArgumentList "/i","$out","/qn","INSTALLLEVEL=1000" -Wait -NoNewWindow

      - name: Create WinFsp MSI placeholder for resource glob
        shell: powershell
        run: New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "apps/desktop/src-tauri/resources/winfsp-placeholder.msi"

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: windows-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: windows-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features winfsp

  cargo-test-macos:
    name: Cargo Test (macOS)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-macos]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-macos.result == 'success'
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install FUSE-T
        run: |
          brew install --cask fuse-t
          sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig
          sudo ln -sf "/Library/Application Support/fuse-t/pkgconfig/fuse-t.pc" /usr/local/lib/pkgconfig/fuse.pc

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: macos-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: macos-cargo-

      - name: Run Rust tests
        run: cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --features fuse
        env:
          PKG_CONFIG_PATH: /opt/homebrew/lib/pkgconfig:/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

  cargo-test-linux:
    name: Cargo Test + Coverage (Linux)
    needs: [changes, cargo-check-linux]
    if: |
      !failure() && !cancelled() &&
      needs.cargo-check-linux.result == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev \
            libayatana-appindicator3-dev \
            librsvg2-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libxdo-dev \
            libfuse3-dev \
            pkg-config \
            build-essential

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: rustup default stable

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            apps/desktop/src-tauri/target
          key: linux-cargo-${{ hashFiles('apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: linux-cargo-

      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-llvm-cov

      - name: Run Rust tests with coverage
        run: >-
          cargo llvm-cov
          --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
          --no-default-features --features fuse
          --lcov --output-path desktop-lcov.info

      - name: Upload desktop coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: desktop-lcov.info
          flags: desktop
          fail_ci_if_error: false

- **Added** `changes` job with `dorny/paths-filter` (same desktop file patterns, referencing `e2e-desktop.yml` instead of `ci.yml`)

- **Binary path** now points to `apps/desktop/src-tauri/target/debug/` instead of `desktop-binary/`
- **Gate logic**: skips when no desktop changes detected (unless `workflow_dispatch`)
- **Timeout** bumped 30 → 45 min to accommodate the build step

Ready to commit and push when you are.

fix(ci): consolidate desktop E2E pipeline and add Rust tests

Remove fragile cross-workflow artifact dependency where e2e-desktop.yml
downloaded debug binaries from CI's build-desktop-* jobs. When CI skipped
those builds (no desktop file changes), E2E failed with "Artifact not found."

- Make e2e-desktop.yml self-contained: builds its own debug binaries
- Add change detection (dorny/paths-filter) to e2e-desktop.yml
- Add cargo-test-{windows,macos,linux} jobs to ci.yml, gated on
  cargo-check passing
- Add Rust coverage via cargo-llvm-cov on Linux, uploaded to Codecov

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"

- Make `e2e-desktop.yml` self-contained: adds change detection, builds its own debug binaries, then runs E2E tests
- Add `cargo-test-{windows,macos,linux}` jobs to CI, gated on `cargo-check` passing — runs the existing 8 test files (crypto vectors, sync queue, FUSE cache, file handles, device registry, auth commands, tray status)
- Add Rust coverage via `cargo-llvm-cov` on Linux, uploaded to Codecov with `desktop` flag

## Test plan
- [ ] CI runs `cargo-check-*` → `cargo-test-*` on PRs with desktop changes
- [ ] `cargo-test-linux` uploads coverage to Codecov
- [ ] Push to main with desktop changes → E2E workflow detects changes → builds debug binaries → runs tests
- [ ] Push to main with NO desktop changes → E2E workflow skips (`changes.outputs.desktop=false`)
- [ ] Manual `workflow_dispatch` on e2e-desktop → always runs full pipeline
